title: Should attendance be mandatory in Indian colleges?
description: The debate examines whether Indian colleges should require minimum classroom attendance for academic eligibility and learning.

facts.fact: The University Grants Commission's undergraduate framework prescribes a minimum of 75% attendance in each course.
Attendance requirements give institutions a consistent basis for examination eligibility and academic monitoring.
Regular attendance can support participation in lectures, discussions, laboratories and continuous assessment.
Attendance rules may disadvantage students managing paid work, internships, health needs or family responsibilities.
Requiring physical presence can limit flexibility even when students can access recorded lectures and online material.
Attendance alone does not measure engagement, comprehension or academic performance.
